notes: Evaluator-owned scope guidance for a source-only tenant/object lookup review. It contains no expected locations or answer-key labels.

vectors.title: Review tenant-scoped object lookup
vectors.rationale: A lookup that receives a subject scope and an object identifier requires source-visible isolation review.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: An object lookup may return data without enforcing the supplied tenant or ownership scope.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies object retrieval and a source-visible missing scope control.

limitations: Static review cannot prove middleware or database row-level policy behavior.
